elements.name: City Domain (UA)
elements.desc: The City domain is concerned with the citizenry, commerce, traffic, and even architecture of modern civilization. In the eyes of a cleric of the city, the center of modern life is a sense and spirit of community, and the gravest enemies of the city are those who seek to harm the common weal of its citizens.

rules.grant: Class Feature:Channel Divinity: Spirits of the City (UA)

elements.name: Protection Domain (UA)
elements.desc: The protection domain is the purview of deities who charge their followers to shield the weak from the strong. The gods’ faithful dwell in villages and towns on the borderlands, where they help bolster defenses and seek out evils to defeat. These gods believe that a strong shield and a suit of armor is the best defense against evil, second only to a stout mace on hand to respond to any attacks in kind.

elements.name: Twilight Domain (UA)
elements.desc: The Twilight Domain governs the transition and blending of light into darkness. It is a time of rest and comfort, but also the threshold between safety and the unknown. Deities of healing or respite, bravery or protection, travel or transition, or the night and dreams might grant their clerics the Twilight Domain. Clerics who serve these deities tend to be brave, delving into the dark to hold its dangers at bay and to bring comfort to those lost far from the light.

elements.name: Unity Domain (UA)
elements.desc: A sense of oneness shines at the heart of healthy communities, whether bound together by friendship, blood, faith, or some other uniting force. The gods of unity deepen such bonds and delight in their strength. Clerics of these gods preside over marriages and other familial bonding customs, but they also nurture the emotional bonds of friendship and camaraderie. Their divine blessings bolster and protect allies in battle through these deep bonds and turn aside malign influences.

elements.name: Bonus Cantrip (City UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level City Domain feature.

When you choose this domain at 1st level, you gain the On/Off cantrip in addition to your chosen cantrips.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiencies (City UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level City Domain feature.

Also starting at 1st level, you gain proficiency with sidearms and proficiency with vehicles (land).

elements.name: Heart of the City (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level City Domain feature.

From 1st level, you are able to tap into the spirit of community found in the city. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.id: Class Feature:Channel Divinity: Spirits of the City (UA)
elements.name: Channel Divinity: Spirits of the City (UA)
elements.desc:
2nd-level City Domain feature.

Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to call on the city for aid. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Block Watch (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level City Domain feature.

Starting at 6th level, your awareness while in the city extends preternaturally. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Divine Strike (City UA)
elements.desc:
8th-level City Domain feature.

At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with psychic energy borrowed from the citizens of your city. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Express Transit (UA)
elements.desc:
17th-level City Domain feature.

At 17th level, you can use mass transit routes to transport instantaneously to other points in the city. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiency (Protection UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Protection Domain feature.

When you choose this domain at 1st level, you gain proficiency with heavy armor.

elements.name: Shield of the Faithful (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Protection Domain feature.

Starting at 1st level, you gain the ability to hinder attacks intended for others. When a creature attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Channel Divinity: Radiant Defense (UA)
elements.desc:
2nd-level Protection Domain feature.

Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to cloak your allies in radiant armor. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Blessed Healer (Protection UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Protection Domain feature.

Beginning at 6th level, the healing spells you cast on others can heal you as well. When you cast a spell with a spell slot and it restores hit points to any creature other than you this turn, you regain hit points equal to 2 + the spell’s level.

elements.name: Divine Strike (Protection UA)
elements.desc:
8th-level Protection Domain feature.

At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage to the target. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Indomitable Defense (UA)
elements.desc:
17th-level Protection Domain feature.

At 17th level, you gain resistance to two damage types of your choice, choosing from bludgeoning, necrotic, piercing, radiant, and slashing. Whenever you finish a short or long rest, you can change the damage types you chose. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiencies (Twilight UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Twilight Domain feature.

At 1st level, you gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

elements.name: Eyes of Night (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Twilight Domain feature.

Starting at 1st level, your eyes are blessed, allowing you to see through the deepest gloom. You have darkvision with no maximum range; you can see in dim light as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Vigilant Blessing (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Twilight Domain feature.

At 1st level, the night has taught you to be vigilant. As an action, you give one creature you touch (including possibly yourself) advantage on your next initiative roll the creature makes. This benefit ends immediately after the roll or if you use this feature again.

elements.name: Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary (UA)
elements.desc:
2nd-level Twilight Domain feature.

At 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to refresh your allies with soothing twilight. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Steps of the Brave (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Twilight Domain feature.

Starting at 6th level, you draw strength from your connection to twilight and find yourself at home within its dark embrace, gaining two benefits. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Divine Strike (Twilight UA)
elements.desc:
8th-level Twilight Domain feature.

At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 psychic damage. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.

elements.name: Midnight Shroud (UA)
elements.desc:
17th-level Twilight Domain feature.

At 17th level, you can harness the shrouding power of night to protect your allies and stymie your foes. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Emboldening Bond (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Unity Domain feature.

Starting at 1st level, you can forge an empowering bond between allies. As an action, you can choose two willing creatures you can see within 30 feet of you (this can include yourself) and create a magical bond between them. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Channel Divinity: Shared Burden (UA)
elements.desc:
2nd-level Unity Domain feature.

Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to protect your allies through the strength of your shared bonds. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Protective Bond (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Unity Domain feature.

Beginning at 6th level, the bond you forge between people shields them from harm. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Potent Spellcasting (Unity UA)
elements.desc:
8th-level Unity Domain feature.

Beginning at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

elements.name: Enduring Unity (UA)
elements.desc:
17th-level Unity Domain feature.

At 17th level, the bonds you create endure across vast distances. See the side panel for the full text.
